accepted.id: multistep: pan: over-redacted — all surrounding context destroyed
accepted.why: The PAN span loses its own context once the adjacent name is redacted. This is the single point behind the honest 98% (49/50) redaction-precision figure reported to the SPOC. Fixing it means teaching redaction to preserve a neighbouring span's context, which has not been attempted.
